pages.text: A $(l)Team$() is for playing together for good.$(br2)Make one in the $(l)Team$() tab of the Statistics screen ($(l)H$()): give it a name and pick what it shares. That can't be changed later, to change it you leave and make a new team.$(br2)Joining a teammate's vault puts you in their $(l:useful_commands/party_commands)$(l)party$().

$(l)Vault XP$(): all vault XP a teammate earns, from anything, also goes to everyone, even while they are $(l)offline$(). A vault you run together pays everyone the best run once.$(br2)$(l)Research$(): every new $(l:skills/researches)$(l)Research$() one teammate unlocks is unlocked for the whole team.

$(l)Transmogs$(): every new transmog a teammate discovers is discovered for everyone. Patreon and reward transmogs stay personal.$(br2)Only what's unlocked $(l)while you're in the team$() is shared, nothing from before.$(br2)Leaving a team keeps every level, Research and transmog you have.

pages.title: Team Commands
pages.text: $(li)$(8)$(l)/the_vault team create <name>$()$(li2)Makes a team that shares Vault XP and Research$()$(br)$(li)$(8)$(l)/the_vault team invite <player>$()$(li2)Invites a player to your team$()$(br)$(li)$(8)$(l)/the_vault team accept <player>$()$(li2)Accepts a team invite$()$(br)$(li)$(c:/the_vault team list)$(t:Click to execute this command)$(l)/the_vault team list$()$(li2)Lists all members$()$(br)$(li)$(c:/the_vault team leave)$(t:Click to execute this command)$(l)/the_vault team leave$()$(li2)Leaves the team$()
